name: view_duel_seawall_key
description: F bursts a Seawall (design 1.4, contract-m7.md §3) on Undertow's own rules against the caretaker. In a build window, or in a wave without a charge, F is refused here with why and nothing goes out. Eight lives lost (the logged lives setter) earn two charges. With them, F in a wave sends SEAWALL: the surf rises round my Holdfast where the simulation measures the ring (EV_SEAWALL's x and z, the road's end) and runs out to its radius (EV_SEAWALL's r, the rules' 3 m), its sound plays, the creep near the Holdfast is stunned and wounded by a quarter of its health, a charge is spent and the duel bar counts down the cooldown, during which F is refused ('The Seawall is still standing'). The surf is gone within a second and a half. After the cooldown F bursts the last charge, and then there is none.

steps.assert: node('Notice').text == 'The Seawall bursts during a wave' and resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').sent(1, 8).is_empty()
steps.msg: in a build window F is refused here
eight lives lost: two charges on the bar
F sent SEAWALL and spent a charge
the surf rises round my Holdfast, where the rules measure the ring
out to the rules' 3 m, with its sound
the creep near the Holdfast is stunned and loses a quarter of its health

steps.assert: node('DuelBar').lines()[0].contains('Seawall 1 (F) · ready in 15 s') or node('DuelBar').lines()[0].contains('Seawall 1 (F) · ready in 14 s')
steps.msg: the bar counts down the cooldown

steps.assert: node('Notice').text == 'The Seawall is still standing' and resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').sent(1, 8).size() == 1
steps.msg: while it stands, F is refused here
the surf is gone within a second and a half
still in the wave when the cooldown ends
after it, F bursts the last charge
